From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@swiftretail.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: SIG questionnaire: request for pentest appendices (scope + logs)

Hi Kimberly,

We're working through the SIG questionnaire for our procurement review and the pen test report is listed as a required artifact under the "Offensive Security" section. Can you upload the following to our GRC portal (link below) by next Tuesday, Oct 26?

- Full penetration test report (PDF) + appendices
- Raw appendices if possible (exploit traces, packet captures, authenticated logs) — redacted if necessary
- A mapping CSV that ties report findings to SIG questions
- A short attestation that redactions were performed and no PII remains

If you prefer SFTP, we can provide credentials; otherwise, please use: https://grc.swiftretail.com/upload/REQ-4482

Thanks — this is blocking our compliance review for Q4.

Regards,
Liam O'Connell
Security Program Manager
Swift Retail

Attachment: request-checklist.txt (text)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: request for pentest appendices (scope + logs)

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the full report and appendices but will need to follow our redaction policy for any customer or internal PII. A few quick clarifying questions before we prepare the upload:

1) Does Swift Retail require unredacted exploit scripts or are redacted reproductions acceptable?
2) For raw packet captures / logs, is removal of internal IPs and customer identifiers sufficient, or do you require full tokenization hashes?
3) Do you prefer direct portal upload or a secured SFTP drop (we can do either).

Plan from our side: Marcus will prepare redacted appendices and an evidence mapping CSV. Vanessa will coordinate the compliance attestation and the GRC upload. We aim to have a staging upload for your review by Mon Oct 25, final by Tue Oct 27 if redaction approval is required.

I'm attaching our internal evidence checklist to speed review.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pt-evidence-checklist.txt (text)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: request for pentest appendices (scope + logs)

Kim / Vanessa —

Quick technical note on deliverables from the offensive team:

- We will not share exploit scripts that contain third-party PoC code verbatim; instead we'll provide redacted reproductions and detailed step summaries (method, affected component, PoC steps abstracted).
- Packet captures (pcaps) will be provided with internal IPs and any customer-identifying headers redacted. Timestamps retained.
- Authenticated logs will be sampled and redacted; we will supply corresponding regex/hash mapping where feasible.

ETA: I'm targeting Oct 25 for the redaction bundle (redaction_report_notes.md + ioc_list.csv). For remediation status, see the high-level plan below:
  - Critical findings: fixed in prod 2026-10-22, patch rollout complete
  - High findings: fixes in staging; PROD rollout scheduled 2026-10-29
  - Medium: remediation backlog, estimated completion 2026-11-12

I'll attach the redaction notes and initial IOC list now — we'll update the bundle prior to upload.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redaction_report_notes.md (text), ioc_list.csv (csv)

Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: request for pentest appendices (scope + logs)

Kim, Marcus —

Thanks for the quick response and the plan. A couple of clarifications:

- We do not require exploit scripts that would allow reproduction in our environment; redacted reproductions are fine.
- For pcaps and logs, redaction of customer identifiers + internal IPs is acceptable.
- We do require a signed attestation that redaction was performed by an authorised member of your security team. Please sign the attestation via the DocuSign link below:

DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/Signing/?s=ABCD1234efgh5678

If you can upload a staging bundle by Oct 25 we will review and confirm acceptance; if everything looks good we'll mark the SIG item as complete.

Would you like to schedule a 30-min call Thu (22nd) or Fri (23rd) to walk the mapping?

Regards,
Liam
